$comment: #EXP-2172 (the approved redesign, session 64abb994) THE CI PAGE AS ONE genUI TREE, the same on every platform (ci-page.json says what; this pins HOW, node for node). A case: `world` (`scenario` = ci-page.json's scenario; `empty` = it without runs, jobs, pull requests and runners), `tab` (runs | train | runners), `filter` {status, repositoryId, source} (null = All), `phone` → `tree` (A2UI nested nodes: id, component, props, children, slots, on). Only the current tab's panel is built (the others are empty stacks); the platform adds its own page chrome (title, back) and maps the events: ci-tab / ci-filter-status / ci-filter-repo / ci-filter-source carry the control's value (`all` = no filter), ci-open-run {run} (the Table's rowPress context binds `id` relative to the pressed row), ci-open-pr {pr}, ci-open-runner {device}, ci-open-runners (the runner Chip: opens the Runners tab). The runner row's offline meta is a `fill` + `formatRelativeTime` call the renderer evaluates. The reference is apps/web/src/lib/ci-page-view.ts (its test replays this file); desktop, iOS and Android build the same trees. Regenerate after a deliberate change with `bun apps/web/scripts/bless-ci-page-view.ts` and review the diff. #EXP-2169 ("one look", Danny 2026-11-27: the CI and repo pages looked unlike the rest of the app): the tab strip is `Tabs{pill}` (the repo page's and the board's view switcher), the filter bar ONE `Toolbar` of three `Select{triggerVariant: button}` pickers (status `copy.filterLabels.status` over copy.filters, repository, source; the old Segmented + pill Selects are gone) with the runner `Chip` as its trailing slot on wide only; a case with a `repositoryId` (no tab, no filter) is THE REPO PAGE'S RUNS TAB (`ciRepoRunsTree`): that repository's runs in the Runs tab's day Sections and rows, no filter bar, its EmptyState `copy.empty.runs`; every platform's repo page builds it from its CI page data.
